KKA0155-A018.lead: A one-piece chopper with a broad rectangular blade for everyday vegetable and meat prep.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Full SS Chopper - A018 is made entirely of stainless steel, grip included, so there is no wooden or plastic joint where food scraps can lodge. Its listing photo marks it at 31.5 cm end to end, with a blade 8.5 cm deep.

The wide, flat face does double duty as a scoop: slice onions, tomatoes or cabbage, then carry the pieces straight to the pan. Oval dimples pressed into the handle give the fingers a place to settle during long prep shifts.
b: Build: One piece of metal from cutting edge to handle end.
Size: 31.5 cm overall length; 8.5 cm from spine to edge.
Grip: Row of pressed oval dimples along the handle.
Listed weight: 310 g.
KKA0155-A018.suit: Restaurant and hotel prep counters, canteens and caterers slicing vegetables and boneless meat in volume.
KKA0155-A018.care: Wash by hand after use and dry straight away, paying attention to the dimples. Hang it or slot it into a knife block with the edge facing away from anyone reaching past.
KKA0155-A018.title: Full SS Chopper A018, 31.5 cm
KKA0155-A018.meta: Full SS Chopper A018 from Kitchenary Kart: one-piece stainless steel, 31.5 cm long with an 8.5 cm deep blade, for slicing vegetables and boneless meat.

KKA0156-A019.lead: Model A019 is a one-piece metal chopper for cutting vegetables and boneless meat at a busy prep station.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Full SS Chopper - A019 has its blade and handle formed in stainless steel, with no rivets or separate scales to work loose over years of washing. The listing puts its weight at 325 g, which gives each downward cut some heft behind it.

A tall rectangular blade keeps knuckles clear of the board while chopping, and the flat side lifts chopped greens, gourds or onions off the surface in one go. Pressed indents along the handle give a firmer hold when hands are wet.
b: Material: Stainless steel throughout, grip included.
Blade: Straight-edged rectangular cleaver shape with a flat face.
Handle: Metal grip with oval indents pressed along its length.
Listed weight: 325 g.
KKA0156-A019.suit: Dhabas, canteens, restaurant kitchens and caterers chopping onions, gourds, leafy greens and boneless meat.
KKA0156-A019.care: Rinse off food straight after chopping, wash with a mild detergent and dry before storing. Keep the edge in a guard or on a hook, never loose in a drawer.
KKA0156-A019.title: Full SS Chopper A019, Dimpled Grip
KKA0156-A019.meta: Kitchenary Kart Full SS Chopper A019: all stainless steel, 325 g listed weight, with a dimpled metal grip for chopping vegetables and boneless meat.
conflicts: Listing photos are the same images used on KKA0155-A018 and there is no A019 dimension photo, so no size is given; only the listed weights differ (310 g vs 325 g).
Photo 4 shows another brand's mark stamped on the blade (reads like 'ZWILLING ... GERMANY'); not used in the copy, owner may want to replace that photo.

KKA0157-A051.lead: A stainless steel chopper with a 9 cm deep blade and a hanging hole, shown cubing pumpkin and halving onions.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Full SS Chopper - A051 measures 29.5 cm overall, with an 18.5 cm cutting edge and a depth of 9 cm, going by the dimensions on its listing photo.

A round hole near the front corner lets it hang from a hook or rail between jobs, keeping the counter clear. The smooth handle curves gently toward its end, and the listing photos show it dicing pumpkin into cubes and cutting through a whole onion.
b: Dimensions: 29.5 cm overall, 18.5 cm edge, 9 cm blade depth.
Material: All stainless steel.
Storage: Hanging hole at the front corner.
Listed weight: 260 g.
KKA0157-A051.suit: Cloud kitchens, hotel prep rooms and caterers cubing pumpkin, potato and onion or portioning boneless meat.
KKA0157-A051.care: Clean it by hand, wipe dry and hang it on a hook out of the way of passing staff. Avoid leaving it wet in the sink, where the edge is hidden under water.
KKA0157-A051.title: Full SS Chopper A051, 29.5 cm
KKA0157-A051.meta: Full SS Chopper A051 by Kitchenary Kart: 29.5 cm stainless steel chopper with an 18.5 cm edge, 9 cm deep blade and a hanging hole for kitchen racks.

KKA0158-GC23.lead: The 23 cm size of the Eco chopper, for shredding and light chopping on a crowded counter.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Green Handle SS Chopper - Eco in the Small size is 23 cm long overall, with a 12.5 cm stainless steel blade that stands 5.8 cm deep, as marked on the dimension photo.
Its short edge is easy to control for fine cabbage shreds, garlic, ginger and herbs, and the listing shows it shredding a cabbage head on an end-grain board.
b: Handle: Green grip with light grey bolster and end cap, fixed by three rivets.
Small size: 23 cm overall, 12.5 cm blade length, 5.8 cm deep.
Hanging hole: Cut into the top corner.
KKA0158-GC23.suit: Compact restaurants, cafés, tiffin services and home kitchens shredding cabbage and chopping garlic, ginger and herbs.
KKA0158-GC23.care: Wash by hand, dry the steel and the riveted grip thoroughly, and hang or sheathe it with the edge turned away from the work area.
KKA0158-GC23.title: Green Handle SS Chopper Eco, Small 23 cm
KKA0158-GC23.meta: Small Green Handle SS Chopper - Eco from Kitchenary Kart: 23 cm overall, 12.5 cm stainless blade and riveted grip, for shredding and fine chopping.

KKA0159-GC28.5.lead: The larger Eco chopper, 28.5 cm long and 7.7 cm deep at the blade, for bulk vegetable work.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Green Handle SS Chopper - Eco in the Big size runs 28.5 cm overall and carries an 18 cm stainless steel blade, per the dimension photo on the listing.

A longer edge covers more of a capsicum, cabbage or bunch of greens with each stroke, which saves time when a caterer is preparing vegetables for a large order. The photos show it cutting a whole capsicum beside minced garlic and chillies.
b: Handle: Green grip with light grey bolster and end cap, fixed by three rivets.
Big size: 28.5 cm overall, 18 cm blade length, 7.7 cm deep.
Storage: A hole in the top corner takes a wall hook.
KKA0159-GC28.5.suit: Caterers, canteens, hotel kitchens and restaurants chopping capsicum, cabbage, onions and greens in bulk.
KKA0159-GC28.5.care: Wash by hand, dry the steel and the riveted grip thoroughly, and hang or sheathe it with the edge turned away from the work area.
KKA0159-GC28.5.title: Green Handle SS Chopper Eco, Big 28.5 cm
KKA0159-GC28.5.meta: Big Green Handle SS Chopper - Eco by Kitchenary Kart: 28.5 cm long, 18 cm stainless blade 7.7 cm deep, riveted grip for bulk vegetable prep.

KKA0160-HWC10.lead: A 10-inch cleaver with a listed weight of 700 g, built for splitting bones and heavy cuts.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Super Heavy Wooden Handle SS Bone Chopper - 10" pairs a broad stainless steel blade with a timber grip held by three rivets. At a listed 700 g, the tool's own weight does much of the work as it comes down on chicken, mutton or fish bones.

Hold it firmly, keep the free hand well back and let the blade drop through the joint rather than forcing it. A hole near the top corner lets it hang on a hook beside the block, and the listing photos show it portioning raw meat on a board.
b: Blade: Stainless steel, 10-inch size, with a hanging hole.
Handle: Wood, secured with three metal rivets.
Heft: 700 g listed, putting force behind each chop.
KKA0160-HWC10.suit: Butcher shops, meat and poultry counters, mutton and biryani kitchens, and hotel butchery sections.
KKA0160-HWC10.care: Scrape off fat and bone fragments, wash by hand and dry the timber grip well; never leave it soaking. Store it on a hook or in a guard with the edge facing the wall.
KKA0160-HWC10.title: Heavy SS Bone Chopper 10", Wooden Handle
KKA0160-HWC10.meta: Super heavy 10" SS bone chopper from Kitchenary Kart: riveted wooden handle, 700 g listed weight and hanging hole, for chicken, mutton and rib bones.

KKA0161-SHSH.lead: A sharpening stone that sits in its own moulded base, so it stays put on the counter while a blade is worked across it.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Heavy Knife Sharpening Stone with Casing is a grey abrasive block seated in a fitted plastic tray. Assembled, the unit measures 19.5 cm long, 5.5 cm wide and 3.5 cm high, and the listing gives its weight as 349 g.

Set it on a flat surface, hold the knife at a low, steady angle and draw the edge along the stone from heel to tip, then repeat on the other side. The photos also show it touching up a pair of scissors.
b: Size: 19.5 x 5.5 x 3.5 cm overall.
Casing: Moulded tray that keeps the stone steady; the stone lifts out for washing.
Listed weight: 349 g.
KKA0161-SHSH.suit: Restaurant and hotel kitchens, butcher counters and caterers keeping knives and kitchen scissors keen.
KKA0161-SHSH.care: Brush or rinse away the grey metal residue after each session and let the stone air-dry completely before it goes back into the tray.
KKA0161-SHSH.title: Heavy Knife Sharpening Stone with Casing
KKA0161-SHSH.meta: Heavy Knife Sharpening Stone with Casing from Kitchenary Kart: 19.5 x 5.5 x 3.5 cm stone in a moulded base that stays put while you sharpen knives.

KKA0162-SHSHH.lead: A hand-held sharpening stone on a long grip, for honing a knife right at the station.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Heavy Knife Sharpening Stone with Casing + Green Handle mounts a grey stone in a plastic holder that extends into a grip. It is 23 cm long overall with a 5 cm wide stone face, and its listed weight is 170 g.

Hold the grip in one hand, rest the knife on the stone and pull the edge across at a steady angle, alternating sides, as the listing photo shows with a kitchen knife. A hole at the far end lets it hang on a hook beside the prep line.
b: Length: 23 cm overall; stone face 5 cm wide.
Holder: Green plastic, with a hanging hole at the grip end.
Listed weight: 170 g.
KKA0162-SHSHH.suit: Line cooks, caterers working off-site and compact kitchens that sharpen knives at the station rather than on a bench.
KKA0162-SHSHH.care: Tap off loose grit, rinse the stone under the tap if it is clogged and hang it up to dry in open air.
KKA0162-SHSHH.title: Heavy Sharpening Stone with Green Handle
KKA0162-SHSHH.meta: Kitchenary Kart Heavy Knife Sharpening Stone with Casing + Green Handle: a 23 cm hand-held stone for honing kitchen knives right at the prep station.

KKA0163-SHSR.lead: A plain rectangular stone with no base or handle, for keeping kitchen knives keen between services.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Regular Knife Sharpening Stone is a bare grey block, shown in the photos in two layers of slightly different shade. With no casing, it can sit on a damp cloth or rubber mat on any flat surface while you work.

Lay the knife almost flat, lift the spine a little and push the edge along the stone in smooth strokes that cover the whole blade, then turn the knife over and match the strokes on the second side. A few passes before each shift keep the kitchen's knives cutting well.
b: Type: Loose rectangular stone without casing or handle.
Surface: Two-layer grey block, as seen in the listing photos.
Use: Chef's, paring and chopping knives, worked by hand.
KKA0163-SHSR.suit: Home bakers, small cafés and restaurant kitchens that sharpen a few knives by hand each week.
KKA0163-SHSR.care: Wipe away the dark metal slurry after use, rinse under running water and stand the stone on its edge to dry before it goes into a drawer.
KKA0163-SHSR.title: Regular Knife Sharpening Stone
KKA0163-SHSR.meta: Regular Knife Sharpening Stone from Kitchenary Kart: a plain grey block for restoring the edge on chef's, paring and chopping knives on any flat counter.
conflicts: Listing weight 55 g does not match the 20 x 5 x 2.5 cm stone in the dimension photo (a stone that size weighs several hundred grams); size and weight left out of the copy.

KKA0164-SHS3L.lead: A pull-through sharpener with three slots that lets staff restore a working edge without learning stone technique.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Knife Sharpener 3 Slot with Plastic Handle has three slots fitted with stainless steel inserts, set in a black body with a red grip. It measures 19.5 cm long, 5.5 cm wide and 3.5 cm high, with a listed weight of 166 g.

Rest the base on the counter, press down on the grip with one hand and pull the knife through a slot, heel first, several times with light pressure, as the listing photo shows. Because the blade only has to be drawn through, a new helper can keep the house knives sharp after a minute's instruction.
b: Slots: Three, lined with stainless steel inserts.
Size: 19.5 x 5.5 x 3.5 cm.
Grip: Red and black plastic handle for holding the unit down.
Listed weight: 166 g.
KKA0164-SHS3L.suit: Busy restaurant lines, cloud kitchens, canteens and homes where several people share the same knives.
KKA0164-SHS3L.care: Tap the metal filings out over a bin, wipe the body with a damp cloth and keep it dry; do not soak it or put it in a dishwasher.
KKA0164-SHS3L.title: 3 Slot SS Knife Sharpener, Plastic Handle
KKA0164-SHS3L.meta: SS Knife Sharpener 3 Slot with Plastic Handle from Kitchenary Kart: pull-through design with steel inserts in a 19.5 cm body, for quick edge touch-ups.

KKA0165-SHR25.lead: A 25 cm sharpening rod for bringing an edge back between full sharpenings.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Knife Sharpening Rod with Black Handle in the 25cm size is marked on its listing photo as a 10-inch rod on a 5-inch grip. A guard at the front keeps fingers behind the rod, and a ring at the end lets it hang on a hook.

Stand the rod upright with its tip on a board, place the heel of the knife near the top at about 20 to 25 degrees, the angle drawn in the photos, and sweep the blade down and across so the whole edge meets the steel. Alternate sides for a few strokes each before chopping or carving.
b: Build: Stainless steel rod, black handle, finger guard and hanging ring.
25cm size: Rod section 10 inches long.
Angle guide: Photos show a 20 to 25 degree stroke.
KKA0165-SHR25.suit: Chefs and butchers who touch up knives several times a shift, and hotel kitchens that carve meat at the pass.
KKA0165-SHR25.care: Wipe the rod with a damp cloth to clear metal dust, dry it and hang it by the ring away from the counter edge.
KKA0165-SHR25.title: SS Knife Sharpening Rod 25cm, Black Handle
KKA0165-SHR25.meta: 25cm SS Knife Sharpening Rod with Black Handle from Kitchenary Kart: 10-inch rod with finger guard and hanging ring, for keeping knife edges keen.

KKA0166-SHR30.lead: The 30 cm sharpening rod, with extra length for slicing, bread and chef's knives.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Knife Sharpening Rod with Black Handle in the 30cm size carries a 12-inch rod on a 5-inch grip, going by the listing photo.

The added reach lets a big blade run its full edge along the steel in a single stroke. Hold the knife at roughly 20 to 25 degrees, as the photo diagram shows, work each side alternately and finish with one or two light passes.
b: Build: Stainless steel rod, black handle, finger guard and hanging ring.
30cm size: Rod section 12 inches long.
Reach: Room for long carving and bread knives in one sweep.
KKA0166-SHR30.suit: Butcher shops, banquet carving stations and bakeries honing long bread and slicing knives.
KKA0166-SHR30.care: Wipe the rod with a damp cloth to clear metal dust, dry it and hang it by the ring away from the counter edge.
KKA0166-SHR30.title: SS Knife Sharpening Rod 30cm, Black Handle
KKA0166-SHR30.meta: 30cm SS Knife Sharpening Rod with Black Handle by Kitchenary Kart: 12-inch steel rod for honing long carving, bread and chef's knives at 20 to 25 degrees.

KKA0167-PBKBT10.lead: A 10-inch bread knife with coarse, widely spaced serrations that grip a hard crust on the first stroke.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth in the 10" size measures 37 cm overall on its listing photo, with a long straight blade and a moulded plastic grip.

Large serrations saw through baguettes, pav, sourdough and crusty buns with an easy back-and-forth motion, as the photo of a sliced baguette shows. Let the knife do the cutting instead of pressing down, and the crumb keeps its shape.
b: Handle: Black plastic, shaped with a rounded end.
10" size: 37 cm long overall.
Edge: Coarse teeth from heel to tip.
KKA0167-PBKBT10.suit: Bakeries, cafés and hotel breakfast counters slicing baguettes, pav and crusty loaves.
KKA0167-PBKBT10.care: Wash by hand with a soft brush along the serrations, dry at once and keep it in a sheath or knife rack so the edge stays away from fingers and other tools.
KKA0167-PBKBT10.title: Bread Knife, Big Teeth, Black Handle 10"
KKA0167-PBKBT10.meta: 10" Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth from Kitchenary Kart: 37 cm long, with coarse serrations for baguettes, pav and crusty loaves.

KKA0168-PBKBT12.lead: The 12-inch coarse-toothed bread knife, with reach to cross a wide sourdough or sandwich loaf in one pass.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth in the 12" size is 42 cm end to end on the listing photo, with a moulded plastic grip.

The added length helps on wide loaves and baguettes, where a shorter blade would need several strokes to get through. Keep each stroke smooth and light so the serrations open the crust without tearing the soft middle.
b: Handle: Black plastic, shaped with a rounded end.
12" size: 42 cm long overall.
Serration: Large teeth spaced well apart along the whole edge.
KKA0168-PBKBT12.suit: Bakery counters, hotel buffets and sandwich kitchens cutting long or wide loaves.
KKA0168-PBKBT12.care: Wash by hand with a soft brush along the serrations, dry at once and keep it in a sheath or knife rack so the edge stays away from fingers and other tools.
KKA0168-PBKBT12.title: Bread Knife, Big Teeth, Black Handle 12"
KKA0168-PBKBT12.meta: 12" Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth by Kitchenary Kart: 42 cm overall, with a coarse-toothed blade for wide loaves and baguettes.

KKA0169-PBKST10.lead: A 10-inch knife with fine, closely set serrations for soft loaves, buns and thin even slices.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth in the 10" size is 37 cm overall with a slim 3 cm wide blade, as marked on the listing photo.

Fine serrations slice soft sandwich loaves, burger buns and tea cakes with few crumbs, and still work through a crusty loaf. The listing photos show it cutting a round country loaf and carving a roast joint.
b: Grip: Black moulded plastic with a thicker, curved butt.
10" size: 37 cm overall; blade 3 cm wide.
Edge: Fine, closely spaced teeth.
KKA0169-PBKST10.suit: Sandwich shops, cafés, bakeries and hotel kitchens slicing pav, buns and roast meat.
KKA0169-PBKST10.care: Hand-wash in warm soapy water, wipe dry from the spine outward and store the knife in a rack or cover rather than loose among other utensils.
KKA0169-PBKST10.title: Bread Knife, Small Teeth, Black Handle 10"
KKA0169-PBKST10.meta: 10" Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth from Kitchenary Kart: 37 cm long, 3 cm blade, fine serrations for soft bread, buns and roasts.

KKA0170-PBKST12.lead: The 12-inch fine-tooth bread knife, with extra reach for long loaves and carving.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth in the 12" size runs 42 cm overall with a 3 cm wide blade, going by the dimension photo.
The extra length handles long sandwich loaves and larger roasts, since each slice can be finished in one smooth pull. Its fine serrations leave a neat face on soft crumb.
b: Grip: Black moulded plastic with a thicker, curved butt.
12" size: 42 cm overall; blade 3 cm wide.
Serration: Small teeth set close together.
KKA0170-PBKST12.suit: Bakeries, banquet kitchens and delis cutting long sandwich loaves and carving roast meat.
KKA0170-PBKST12.care: Hand-wash in warm soapy water, wipe dry from the spine outward and store the knife in a rack or cover rather than loose among other utensils.
KKA0170-PBKST12.title: Bread Knife, Small Teeth, Black Handle 12"
KKA0170-PBKST12.meta: 12" Plastic Black Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth by Kitchenary Kart: 42 cm overall, fine-toothed 3 cm blade for long loaves and carving roasts.

KKA0171-PKK9.lead: A 9-inch serrated kitchen knife for tomatoes, cucumbers and other produce with firm skins.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Handle Kitchen Knife with Teeth - 9" is 9 inches from tip to butt, with a pointed, finely serrated blade and a black contoured grip finished with a silver-toned end cap.
The teeth catch a tomato skin without crushing the flesh, so slices stay even for salads, burgers and sandwiches. The listing photos show it slicing tomatoes, cucumber and carrots on a wooden board.
b: Length: 9 inches overall.
Edge: Fine serrations running to a pointed tip.
Handle: Black plastic with a silver-toned end cap.
Listed weight: 110 g.
KKA0171-PKK9.suit: Salad and sandwich stations, bar garnish prep, cafés and quick-service kitchens slicing tomatoes and vegetables.
KKA0171-PKK9.care: Wash it by hand rather than leaving it in a sink of water, dry it and keep it in a block or knife roll with the tip covered.
KKA0171-PKK9.title: Serrated Kitchen Knife 9", Plastic Handle
KKA0171-PKK9.meta: Plastic Handle Kitchen Knife with Teeth - 9" from Kitchenary Kart: pointed, finely serrated blade and black grip for tomatoes, cucumber and salad prep.
conflicts: Listing photos show 'FARBERWARE' printed on the blade (a third-party brand); brand not used in the copy, owner may want to replace these photos.

KKA0172-PHKWT10.lead: A 10-inch serrated knife for bread and for levelling sponge cakes on a turntable.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth in size 10 has a blade marked 10 inches long on the listing photo and a scalloped serrated edge.

Bakers use this length for buns, small loaves and smaller cake rounds, running the blade level through the sponge to trim a domed top or split a layer, as the turntable photo shows. A light-coloured grip also makes grease and dirt easy to spot.
b: Handle: White plastic with a curved, rounded butt.
Size 10: blade length 10 inches, per the listing photo.
Edge: Rounded scallops cut along its full length.
KKA0172-PHKWT10.suit: Cake shops, home bakers and café kitchens levelling sponges and slicing buns and small loaves.
KKA0172-PHKWT10.care: Wash by hand and dry with the cloth moving from spine to edge, never along it; store in a sheath or knife slot with the serrations covered.
KKA0172-PHKWT10.title: White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth, 10"
KKA0172-PHKWT10.meta: 10" Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth from Kitchenary Kart: scalloped serrated blade for levelling sponge cakes and slicing buns and loaves.

KKA0173-PHKWT12.lead: A 12-inch serrated bread knife sized for wider cakes and full sandwich loaves.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth in size 12 carries a 12-inch serrated blade, as marked on its listing photo.

With 12 inches of edge, the blade spans a larger cake round, so a layer can be split with the knife held level while the turntable is rotated. The same length slices a full sandwich loaf or a row of buns in one go.
b: Handle: White plastic with a curved, rounded butt.
Size 12: blade length 12 inches.
Teeth: Scalloped serrations from heel to tip.
KKA0173-PHKWT12.suit: Bakeries, patisseries and hotel pastry sections splitting cake layers and slicing sandwich loaves.
KKA0173-PHKWT12.care: Wash by hand and dry with the cloth moving from spine to edge, never along it; store in a sheath or knife slot with the serrations covered.
KKA0173-PHKWT12.title: White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth, 12"
KKA0173-PHKWT12.meta: 12" Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth by Kitchenary Kart: long serrated blade for splitting cake layers and slicing full sandwich loaves.

KKA0174-PHKWT14.lead: The longest of the three sizes, with a 14-inch serrated blade for big cakes and long loaves.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth in size 14 has a 14-inch blade with a scalloped edge, per the length marked on the listing photo.

The extra reach lets one pass cross a large celebration cake or a long loaf from side to side, which keeps layers flat and slices straight. Keep this size for wedding tiers, large slab sponges and banquet bread service.
b: Handle: White plastic with a curved, rounded butt.
Size 14: blade length 14 inches.
Serration: Scalloped teeth along the whole edge.
KKA0174-PHKWT14.suit: Cake studios, wedding and banquet caterers and large bakeries handling big cakes and long loaves.
KKA0174-PHKWT14.care: Wash by hand and dry with the cloth moving from spine to edge, never along it; store in a sheath or knife slot with the serrations covered.
KKA0174-PHKWT14.title: White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth, 14"
KKA0174-PHKWT14.meta: 14" Plastic White Handle Bread Knife with Teeth from Kitchenary Kart: a 14-inch serrated blade for large celebration cakes, slab sponges and long loaves.
